name: superhood
description: SUPER HOOD BROS.: WASHINGTON PARK — an 8-bit side-scrolling platformer set in Brooklyn. Three courses (Fifth Avenue in Park Slope, the G train tunnel, and Washington Park), pigeons and rats and trash-can lids, pizza and egg creams and MetroCards, subway tokens for coins, and a landlord boss. Runs entirely in the browser: no build step and no assets on disk — every sprite is drawn from a pixel grid at load time and every sound is synthesised in WebAudio.

endpoints.play: Serve the game in this process and open a browser
endpoints.serve: Run the game server under pm2 and register the gateway route
endpoints.test: Files + JS syntax + every level builds
